text:
marta: Quick idea: add a tiny toggle row above heatmap for fast comparisons — two range pills + sample badge. Mock: https://files.redwood/mini-toggle.png

sam: Nice. How does toggle affect main timepicker?

marta: Does not change global timepicker. Toggles are ephemeral; click 446 to open full picker. Single-click pins, double-click clears.

jin: Sampling visibility? badge shows `1/10`, tooltip: `Sample rate: 1 in 10 requests` + quick pause.

lee: Accessibility: avoid color-only overlap indicators. Use hatch for compare and cross-hatch for overlap. Keyboard: tab into row, arrows move, enter pins, space opens sample popover, esc clears. Add `aria-roledescription="range comparator"`.

alex: Copy nit: microcopy -> "Pin ranges to compare p95 and throughput." Replace ampersand.

ux-bot: Reminder: CI branch `feature/mini-toggle` has failing `heatmap-hover.test`.

sam: I'll debounce hover highlight and add e2e for narrow screens.

marta: Action items: sam fix tests, jin hook analytics event `ui.range_toggle.interact`, lee run a11y smoke, alex sign off copy. I'll post final screenshot here. :sparkles:
